kind: Independent whole-original native keylock recorded-audio review

method.decoder: FFmpeg complete original to little-endian interleaved Float32; no seek/trim/resample/channel reduction
method.spectral: Nonoverlapping1s windows including finalpartial. Float64 demean,Hann,rFFT,global nonDCmaximum,3bin parabolic logmagnitude interpolation. Expectedfrequencies used only afterward to classify. Silence=max(channelRMS)<.005. Everywindow retained.
method.quiet: Every48-frame1ms stereobin across whole recording, joint RMS threshold.005; both-channel threshold independently crosschecked. These are bin RMS observations, not instantaneous continuity or release latency.
method.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 9.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
